svg.aria-label: Architecture: a deterministic import pipeline writes the SQLite archive; a bounded, read-only agent loop answers questions through fixed tools and an evidence gate
svg.text: Code imports the data. The model can only read it through fixed tools, and every number it cites is checked.
tool results go back; the model may query again
reference errors: one tool-free repair, then checked again
The model never writes SQL or touches the database
Every cited number is checked before publishing
A missing value stays null, never zero
Hidden attributes never reach the archive
Charts read their values from tool results only
Every answer keeps its trace: model rounds, each tool call with its arguments, the SQL it ran, token usage and the evidence check.
